title: Exploring Mutanous Malaise
description: Exploring Mutanous Malaise — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many branches connected to Lower Mutanous Malaise and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many branches connected to Lower Mutanous Malaise and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Ok, now all you have to do is explore the branches off of Lower Mutanous Malaise and get the report back to me in a timely fashion. Oh, and I need to talk to you about the doodles. I've seen some bad doodles in my time, but yours have got to be the worst. The smoke you drew coming out of the chimney looked like nostril hair jumping out of a dumpster. Here are the ground rules: no houses (with or without chimneys), no suns, and for King's sake, no doodles of flowers!

Get into the dungeon and scope out the branches off of Lower Mutanous Malaise and return to me, Loremaster Vraile, when you are done exploring.

Turn-in:

All done then? Good job. Now, let me see the report. Hmmmmmmmmmmm. Well, at least you kept the doodles in the margins, but what is this supposed to be? A bird!? Wow, look, doodling isn't your strong suit, but if you insist on continuing to make a mockery of this prestigious art, at least let me give you a few lessons some time. At any rate, good job on exploring the dungeon.

Objectives:

  • Daze Pustain's Pad
  • J'aymz Fatfilled's Pad
  • Toe-Knee Eye-Ow-My-Eye's Pad

Client level range: 25–50
